intro: I'm a software engineer in Sydney and a founding engineer at Kodo, where I build rewards products, including the platform behind AT&T's customer loyalty program. Before that I spent three years at CommBank, most recently as a Staff Software Engineer leading the rebuild of authentication for NetBank, CommBiz, Bankwest and CommSec. I'm also building a sandbox for running AI-generated code, and writing about it in the logs. If you'd like to build something or grab a coffee in Sydney, get in touch.
